title: Concept: Nibbāna
text: Nibbāna Extinguishment Nibbāna is the stilling of all preparations, the cessation of conceptual proliferation.

title: Concept: Dukkha
text: Dukkha Suffering Whatever is impermanent is dukkha.

title: Concept: Vipassanā
text: Vipassanā Insight Insight (vipassanā) sees through the optical illusion of existence.

title: Concept: Jāti
text: Jāti Birth With becoming as condition, birth occurs.

title: Concept: Taṇhā
text: Taṇhā Craving Craving arises from feeling and leads to grasping.

title: Concept: Anicca
text: Anicca Impermanent Seeing impermanence (anicca) leads to disenchantment and release.

title: Concept: Bhava
text: Bhava Becoming Grasping conditions becoming (bhava), which leads to rebirth.

title: Concept: Saṅkhāra
text: Saṅkhāra Formations Ignorance conditions preparations (saṅkhāra), which drive the wheel of existence.

title: Concept: Anattā
text: Anattā Not-self All phenomena are anattā, devoid of an abiding core or ego-entity.

title: Concept: Vedanā
text: Vedanā Feeling Dependent on contact arises feeling, which can be pleasant, painful, or neutral.

title: Concept: Viññāṇa
text: Viññāṇa Consciousness Viññāṇa acts like a magician's trick, projecting an illusory subject-object duality.

title: Concept: Upādāna
text: Upādāna Grasping Upādāna is both the act of grasping and the fuel that sustains the flame of becoming.

title: Concept: Avijjā
text: Avijjā Ignorance Avijjā is the non-comprehension of the Four Noble Truths and Dependent Arising.

title: Concept: Yoniso manasikāra
text: Yoniso manasikāra Wise attention Radical attention attends to the root of phenomena rather than surface appearances.

title: Concept: Jarāmaraṇa
text: Jarāmaraṇa Aging and Death Birth brings in its wake decay and death and the whole mass of suffering.

title: Concept: Sakkāya-diṭṭhi
text: Sakkāya-diṭṭhi View of existing group/body Sakkāya-diṭṭhi is the fundamental delusion that takes five aggregates as 'I' or 'mine'.

title: Concept: Phassa
text: Phassa Contact Dependent on eye and forms arises visual consciousness; the coming together of the three is contact.

title: Concept: Nāmarūpa
text: Nāmarūpa Name-and-Form Consciousness and Name-and-Form are mutually dependent like two sheaves of reeds.

title: Concept: Paṭicca-samuppāda
text: Paṭicca-samuppāda Dependent Origination He who sees Paṭicca-samuppāda sees the Dhamma.

title: Concept: Anusaya
text: Anusaya Underlying tendency Even when dormant, underlying tendencies (anusaya) fuel unwholesome states.

title: Concept: Papañca
text: Papañca Conceptual proliferation Papañca is the proliferation of concepts that leads to illusion and conflict in the mind.

title: Concept: Asaṅkhata
text: Asaṅkhata Unconditioned Nibbāna is the Unprepared element where no preparations hold sway.

title: Concept: Māyā
text: Māyā Illusion / Magic trick The mind constructs a world of illusion, like a magician tricking the audience.

title: Concept: Kalyāṇamitta
text: Kalyāṇamitta Spiritual companion A good friend guides the meditator along the path to liberation.

title: Concept: Papañca-saññā-saṅkhā
text: Papañca-saññā-saṅkhā Concepts, reckonings, or designations characterized by the prolific tendency of concepts The roots of worldly views lie in papañca-saññā-saṅkhā which obscure true seeing.
